parameters.query:
SELECT
  id AS offre_id,
  code_offre,
  intitule,
  client,
  financement,
  budget,
  type_offre,
  methode_selection,
  date_cloture,
  visite_site,
  exigences,
  modalites_paiement,
  donnees_brutes,
  statut,
  created_at
FROM offres
WHERE id = {{ $('Validate Input').first().json.offre_id }};

SELECT
  departement,
  statut,
  avis,
  commentaires,
  valide_par,
  date_validation
FROM fci_outputs
WHERE offre_id = {{ $('Validate Input').first().json.offre_id }}
ORDER BY departement;

SELECT
  client,
  total_offres,
  total_go,
  total_gagnes,
  total_perdus,
  winrate_pct
FROM v_winrate_client
WHERE client ILIKE '%' || (SELECT client FROM offres WHERE id = {{ $('Validate Input').first().json.offre_id }}) || '%'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS nb_patterns_kb,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE fiabilite_score >= 0.8) AS nb_patterns_fiables,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_type = 'resultat_terrain') AS nb_patterns_terrain
FROM knowledge_base
WHERE fiabilite_score >= 0.5;

INSERT INTO resultats_gonogo (offre_id, decision, conditions_motifs, signe_par, resultat_final)
VALUES (
  {{ $('Generate FOR-COM-02').first().json.offre_id }},
  'go',
  'En attente de signature DG — FOR-COM-02 généré le {{ new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10) }}',
  'En attente',
  'en_attente'
)
ON CONFLICT (offre_id) DO UPDATE
  SET conditions_motifs = EXCLUDED.conditions_motifs,
      updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, offre_id, decision, resultat_final, created_at;
